result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the promotional banner has a serious contrast problem making its text nearly unreadable, and the horizontal restaurant carousel is cut off at the right edge without a clear scroll affordance.

issues.description: The '3 free deliveries for you' banner uses white text on a light mint-green background, resulting in very low contrast. The headline and the 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' subtext are difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker green background or dark-colored text on the light banner to meet WCAG contrast ratios (at least 4.5:1 for body text).

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel cuts off the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') at the right screen edge with truncated text and no visible scroll indicator or peeking affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle scroll hint (e.g., partial card peek with consistent padding, pagination dots, or a gradient fade) so users understand the row is horizontally scrollable.
